title: Vite preload helper creates <link> elements that hang in restricted contexts
trigger: Dynamic import() in Chrome extension offscreen document (or sandboxed/restricted context) hangs indefinitely
principle: Vite's __vite__preloadHelper wraps dynamic import() with <link rel='modulepreload'> creation to preload dependencies. In restricted contexts (offscreen documents, sandboxed pages), this DOM manipulation can block or hang without throwing. Bypass with import(/* @vite-ignore */ fullUrl) using chrome.runtime.getURL() to skip the preload helper entirely.

cases.context: import('@techstark/opencv-js') hangs in offscreen document — module evaluates (export fires) but Promise never resolves

applyFor: Chrome extension offscreen documents with dynamic import()
